svg.title: From context residuals to a distribution of answer means
svg.desc: Context and answer tokens are at the bottom of a language model. Continuous upward paths carry the residual streams; left branches show layer updates joining through circled-plus addition nodes. Context residuals after layer ell are blue and answer residuals at the same layer are orange. The context trace feeds a learned metamodel. Averaging the answer token vectors gives one target vector for this rollout. Other possible answers are stacked as y2, y3, and an ellipsis below y1, grouped by a large brace. Their answer means are forecast before generation. Tokens, token boundaries, and activation values are schematic.

g.text: Mean over the sampled answer’s tokens
One orange point per sampled answer
Forecast before any answer is generated
